item.title: Press Coverage: Ryan Day Finds His Head Coach of the Offense By Hiring NFL Veteran Arthur Smith As Offensive Coordinator
item.description: In 2025, Ryan Day brought in a former NFL head coach to be the head coach of his defense, and it yielded great results. Day is now following that same blueprint on offense. Ohio State hired former Pittsburgh Steelers and Tennessee Titans offensive coordinator and Atlanta Falcons head coach Arthur Smith as its OC on Saturday. item.title: No. 10 Iowa Defeats Ohio State, 91-70, to Snap Buckeyes’ Seven-Game Winning Streak
item.description: Ohio State was unable to continue its recent success against top-10 teams vs. Iowa. In a clash of teams who had both won seven straight games entering Sunday, No. 10 Iowa bested No. 12 Ohio State, handing the Buckeyes (18-3, 7-2) their first loss of January in lopsided fashion. item.title: Ohio State Sticking With Veterans, Banking on Development for Offensive Line
item.description: Ohio State will be dependent on development from its offensive line this offseason. The transfer portal closed 10 days ago, and the Buckeyes haven't made any additions on the offensive side of their trenches. They found potential new starters at safety, nickel, defensive tackle, defensive end, wide receiver and tight end, but this late in the cycle, adding a starting-caliber offensive lineman is all but out of the question. item.title: Ohio State Men’s Basketball Game Against Penn State to Be Played As Scheduled
item.description: Ohio State’s Big Ten matchup with Penn State will be played as scheduled despite 12 inches of snowfall in Columbus from Winter Storm Fern. In a press release, the program said roads around the Schottenstein Center have been plowed and treated, though fans are encouraged to use caution when traveling to the game and to allow extra time. item.title: Ohio State Starting Center Christoph Tilly, Sixth Man Gabe Cupps Out vs. Penn State
item.description: Ohio State's already thin roster just got thinner for its Big Ten tilt against Penn State on Monday. Starting center Christoph Tilly and guard Gabe Cupps, the Buckeyes' sixth man since Brandon Noel suffered a major foot injury, are both out vs. the Nittany Lions. Reserve wing Mathieu Grujicic is also sidelined. item.title: Ohio State Hangs On After Losing 18-Point Lead vs. Penn State in 84-78 Victory
item.description: Despite an already thin roster short two additional key pieces, Ohio State gave all appearances of rolling to a victory over lowly Penn State in the first half. But things didn't stay as easy for the Buckeyes. The Nittany Lions pulled all the way back to within a single point after trailing by 18 at halftime. But Ohio State (14-6, 6-4 Big Ten) regained its separation thanks to a crucial string of points from John Mobley Jr. to secure an 84-78 win over Penn State (9-11, 0-9), who remains winless
